features.name: reach_prevalence_sites_log_score
features.description: Smooth reach measure combining prevalence and number of observed sites, using training-fold scaling to reduce skew.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a monotone reach axis with reduced outlier leverage for the linear margin.

features.name: domain_infrastructure_complexity_score
features.description: DNS and host-shape complexity from CNAME use, subdomain breadth, and resource type diversity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures infrastructure complexity that may interact with cross-site behavior while staying dense and bounded.

features.name: resource_script_fetch_mix_score
features.description: Load and script/fetch intensity score combining resource volume with script and fetch shares.
features.expected_model_benefit: Turns heavy-tailed resource counts into a compact continuous workload feature.

features.name: cookie_persistence_volume_score
features.description: Persistence and cookie footprint combining cookie prevalence, first-party cookie count, lifetime, and sent-cookie volume.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the model a smooth persistence axis rather than sparse cookie indicators.

features.name: cookie_api_activity_score
features.description: Runtime cookie-access activity from Document cookie and CookieStore presence plus log-scaled call counts.
features.expected_model_benefit: Separates storage interaction intensity from mere cookie availability through count-aware scaling.
features.formula: np.clip(0.30 * ((api_Document_cookie_getter + api_Document_cookie_setter) / 2.0) + 0.25 * ((api_CookieStore_prototype_getAll + api_CookieStore_prototype_set) / 2.0) + 0.25 * (np.log1p(api_count_Document_cookie_getter + api_count_Document_cookie_setter) / np.log1p(9639.0 + 8939.0)) + 0.20 * (np.log1p(api_count_CookieStore_prototype_getAll + api_count_CookieStore_prototype_set) / np.log1p(236.0 + 239.0)), 0.0, 1.0)

features.name: api_intensity_log_score
features.description: API usage intensity combining distinct API count, total call volume, and weighted fingerprinting activity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Approximates an overall JavaScript instrumentation projection for linear scoring.

features.name: fingerprinting_severity_score
features.description: Severity from declared fingerprinting scores and API weight statistics.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a compact severity measure for rows with concentrated fingerprinting weights.

features.name: api_category_breadth_score
features.description: Breadth across browser surface families such as canvas, audio, navigator, screen, device, storage, timing, media, and WebRTC.
features.expected_model_benefit: Summarizes multi-surface coverage in one dense feature, useful when individual APIs are sparse.

features.name: high_entropy_probe_presence_score
features.description: Fraction of high-entropy browser probes present for canvas, audio, WebGL, navigator, UA data, media devices, WebRTC, performance memory, pixel ratio, and screen size.
features.expected_model_benefit: Preserves interpretable high-entropy probe evidence without requiring many sparse binary coefficients.
features.formula: np.clip((api_HTMLCanvasElement_prototype_toDataURL + api_CanvasRenderingContext2D_prototype_getImageData + api_CanvasRenderingContext2D_prototype_measureText + api_AudioBuffer_prototype_getChannelData + api_OfflineAudioContext_prototype_constructor + api_WebGLRenderingContext_prototype_getParameter + api_WebGLRenderingContext_prototype_getExtension + api_WebGLRenderingContext_prototype_readPixels + api_Navigator_prototype_deviceMemory + api_Navigator_prototype_hardwareConcurrency + api_NavigatorUAData_prototype_getHighEntropyValues + api_MediaDevices_prototype_enumerateDevices + api_RTCPeerConnection_prototype_constructor + api_Performance_prototype_memory + api_window_devicePixelRatio + api_Screen_prototype_width + api_Screen_prototype_height) / 17.0, 0.0, 1.0)

features.name: governance_gap_weighted_score
features.description: Combines sparse ownership/privacy metadata with fingerprinting, API, and cookie indicators; higher when technical signal is high and governance metadata is limited.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the margin to use limited governance metadata as a modifier of technical intensity.

features.name: semantic_stateful_observation_score
features.description: 0.0-1.0 assessor score for how strongly the row suggests persistent state observation across browsing contexts, considering cookies, storage APIs, CNAMEs, prevalence, API breadth, and fingerprinting severity relative to training-fold metadata. Higher means stronger semantic evidence.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds human domain synthesis of weak cues that may be hard to express as a simple algebraic rule.

features.name: semantic_ordinary_service_fit_score
features.description: 0.0-1.0 assessor score for how well the row fits ordinary content delivery, utility measurement, or site functionality: high when owner or policy metadata is present and browser-state/API signals are limited relative to resource volume; low when technical signals concentrate on browser identity or persistence.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a semantic counterweight for high-volume service patterns with weak stateful behavior.
